Testis Extracts  Extractos testiculares; Testicular Extracts. Тестикулярный Экстракт Profile Testis extracts are usually of bovine origin and have been used in a variety of disorders. They have been given to elderly men as androgenic supplements. They have also been used topically, of- ten in preparations containing other mammalian tissue extracts, in the treatment of peripheral circulatory or musculoskeletal dis- orders.
